rows.en: Thank you! Father!
Gavan, what are you going to do?
Yeah, I'm going to hit Makuu's base on Onikubi Island! I'll blow it away without a trace!

…!?

Gavan, what's wrong?
I don't know!?
What is that…!?
Makuu Castle!?
It's ramming into us!

Damn you, Sandoruba!

Mimi, I'm leaving the rest to you!
Space Sheriffs, I'll settle things with you!
Sandoruba! I'm going to avenge my father!
Damn it, Father…
Damn it, Father…
Nuoooh… Space… Sheriffs… curse you!
All right! I'm going into Makuu Castle!
All right! I'm going into Makuu Castle!
Gavan… You have done well to come this far!
So you're Makuu's leader! Don Horror?
Brat… The rest of you, stand back! We'll settle this one-on-one!
Ugh…
How's that, brat…
"Gavan… Once I'm well again, let's fight together, all right? Against Makuu…"
I can't lose! I can't afford to loooose! This is the end! Gavan Dynamic!
Nuoooooh…
You finally found each other, and then this happens so soon…
No… Father is alive, and so is Mother! Here in my heart…
Oh? Poor thing, it's an abandoned dog.
What's wrong? Are you all alone too?
I'll be your friend! Hahaha… Come on, come here.
So this is where Captain Gavan's father was…?

Yes…

According to Mimi, Makuu was carrying out something called Project X here.
And what that plan needs is the blueprint of the laser amplifier…

Anyway, let's look around!

[HERO4], search the whole area!

Right…

Huh…?

Anyway, let's look around!

Come on, [HERO4]!

I mean…

Wait a second…
Huh…!?
Damn… They were already onto us!?
Gavan learned true courage and kindness from his father, Voicer! His fighting spirit burned fiercer than ever…
Until the day you destroy the Makuu remnants who escaped, fight on! Johchaku, Space Sheriff Gavan!
"Joji Yuki is an ally" "Bell Helen is an ally"
Defeat Buffalo Doubler and all Crusher Soldiers!
Defeat all Bem Monsters and Crusher Soldiers!
Defeat Sandoruba, the Bem Monsters and all Crusher Soldiers!
Retsu Ichijouji is defeated
I saw your wife the other day. I hear the baby's due next month, isn't it?
Who are you talking to, Captain…?
Captain Kaji of the MAT Station.

Once the baby comes, you'd better finally settle down and transfer to ground duty, you hear?

Heck… I could even swap places with you. I mean it…
The captain of the MAT Station…
He and the Captain are best friends, since their university days…
Right, you can't go on acting like a bachelor forever. Try putting yourself in your wife's shoes a little…
Huh…
1,000 kilometers from Earth. On this day, an unbelievable disaster struck the MAT Station.
Captain! The voltage inside the station is dropping fast.
Check the generators!

Abnormal reading on the oxygen meter!

I can't believe it… The oxygen inside the station is leaking outside!
What!? Check the liquid oxygen tanks!

Radar Base to Instrument Room…

Floating object detected 500 meters above the station! Closing in fast!
A floating object?

Control Room to Instrument Room…

Power from the energy reactor is being absorbed by the floating object!
This is unbelievable! All the energy inside the station is being sucked out…

MAT Station to MAT HQ!

Emergency! A kaiju has attacked from outer space, it's…
MAT HQ to MAT Station… Respond! Kaji, respond!
A kaiju… in space!?
Captain! At this rate, the kaiju is going to swallow us up!
Kato… I'm leaving the rest to you!

Long-range radar has caught an object floating in the stratosphere!

It's big enough to swallow the MAT Station! It must be a giant creature!

Be careful… Shoot it down the moment you find it! I won't tolerate mistakes! Minami, Ueno, I'm counting on you!
Altitude 60,000 meters…

MAT Arrow to HQ… MAT Arrow to HQ!

Latitude 56 north, longitude 25 east… Floating object sighted at an altitude of 65,000 meters! Moving in!

Roger!

I'll avenge you, I swear it! Kaji… Arrow No. 2, launch at once!
Yes, sir!
Kiiiih, kiiiih!
Waaaaah!
MAT Arrow 1 sighted! It's under attack from an unidentified kaiju!
Ngh… It took a hit and it's still alive!
We can't shoot it down with the MAT Arrow's attacks!
Minami and Ueno are wounded too! Kishida, Go, return to base!
Are you all right?

uncertain: U10441: Voicer's remembered words in 『』 rendered in "double quotes".
U10446-U10449: lines split by narration-kind continuations; kept the splits.
U10450: 隊長 for Gavan rendered "Captain Gavan" (Den Iga is his junior).
U10456-U10457: [HERO4]'s line cut by an ambush.
U10461: two condition strings in 「」 quotes; kept as two quoted items ("is an ally" for 仲間にいる).
U10463/U10464: ベム怪獣 rendered "Bem Monsters" (Makuu's monsters in Gavan).
U10489/U10490: 6百 / 6百5000 read as 6万 / 6万5000 (60,000 m / 65,000 m); 百 seems to be a misread of 万. This also resolves 10百倍 (B0122) and 1000百人 (B0126).
omissions_kept: U10473: Go's bare "ふ～ん…" kept as "Huh…".
